slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The essay states, citing the Ministry of Health's 2023 Annual Performance Report, that eHIS patient registration coverage in primary health care facilities reached 88% in 2023, up from 29% in 2022, with no numerator given and 17 community health centres nationwide; it adds that consultation recording lagged below expectations even after EMR training for 140 doctors.

The essay states that eHIS patient registration was in use in primary health care facilities (community health centres) in 2023, at 88% coverage against 29% in 2022, citing the Ministry of Health's 2023 performance report.

The essay states that primary clinics still record patient data predominantly on paper despite the eHIS rollout, that eHIS implementation begun in 2020 stalled, and that point-of-care recording is hybrid with paper used for consultations; no date is given for this position, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: Primary health care facilities (community health centres); said to integrate surveillance and laboratories centrally

note: Passages file; an AI-assisted compilation by the essay's own account, so each fact is the essay's statement of what the ministry's documents say. The 88% is patient registration coverage in PHCs, not stated as a share of clinics.
